construction: Starting from the 22-crossing representative of 13n_1587 in Applebaum et al. arXiv:2409.09032, encode the diagram as an embedded Tait graph and change the edge corresponding to braid position 20 (zero-based PD row 19). One Reidemeister II removal and three pass moves reduce the changed diagram from 22 to 16 crossings; the reduced endpoint is identified as 10_113, for which u = 1. Hence u(13n_1587) <= 1 + u(10_113) = 2. The complete change-reduce-identify certificate is verified independently here.
lower_bound_status: u = 1 NOT excluded by any computable obstruction: Lickorish linking form, Casson-Walker, HFK^- torsion order (=1), extortion order char 2 (=1), Levine-Tristram (max |sigma_w| = 2). Same fully-resistant class as 12n_491 and 13n_3370.
remark: weak Bernhard-Jablan unknotting number of 13n_1587 is 3 (Applebaum et al.); u <= 2 makes it a BJ-overestimate example; exact u in {1, 2} remains open.
